audit_boundary: Read-only static source adjudication. No application code, configuration, routes, database data, tests, builds, browser state, deployments, commits or pushes were changed or executed.
naming_rule: The five CAP-FIN names are audit-assigned stable FEATURE-IDs after target-specific semantic adjudication. Their split identity is source-supported, but the spellings are not claimed as historical source IDs.

decisions.actor_and_scope: Authenticated finance.dashboard viewer; one selected client and requested period.
decisions.outcome: Client financial position plus chronological drill-down ledger, optionally with running balance.
decisions.boundary: The summary composes the same ledger and adds cost/funding aggregates; ledger is its drill-down. Same actor, client scope, period and review job justify one D capability.

decisions.actor_and_scope: Authenticated finance.dashboard viewer; organisation financial signal scope.
decisions.outcome: Severity-ranked actionable cost, funding, budget, forecast and staffing insights with generation time.
decisions.boundary: Distinct generated signal/exception outcome rather than a period KPI dataset or object-specific financial summary.

decisions.actor_and_scope: Authenticated finance.dashboard viewer; same organisation and requested period.
decisions.outcome: Organisation KPI dataset and its client/site projections.
decisions.boundary: getAll composes the same client and site KPI methods plus staffing. The three routes are aggregate/scoped projections of one dataset family, not separate state or handoff outcomes.

decisions.actor_and_scope: Authenticated finance.dashboard viewer; one selected site and requested period.
decisions.outcome: Full financial dashboard dataset for a single site.
decisions.boundary: The authoritative site object and single-site decision context differ from multi-site comparison and organisation KPI datasets.

decisions.actor_and_scope: Authenticated finance.dashboard viewer; multi-site comparison for the current organisation and requested period.
decisions.boundary: Multi-site comparison is a separate analysis job from one-site detail, despite sharing the dashboard service.

evidence: All eight routes use only permission:finance.dashboard at routes/finance.php:720-742.
FinancialInsightsApiController accepts raw integer site/client identifiers and does not call authorize or a site-access service.
ClientFinancialSummaryService uses Client::withTrashed()->findOrFail without caller/site scoping.
ClientLedgerService filters by supplied client_id but does not establish caller access.
SiteFinancialDashboardService uses Site::findOrFail for single-site detail; only the multi-site overview applies the supplied organisation filter.
No target-specific direct-object denial test was found for these eight endpoints in the static test inventory.
security_evidence_gap.proof_boundary: This proves an absent controller/service-level direct-object guard in the inspected path. It does not prove exploitability for every deployed role or that finance.dashboard is intended to be site-limited; representative-role runtime execution was not performed.
